methodology: Interleaved before/after runs with reversed order on alternate trials; fresh browser contexts, 1600x1000 viewport, external Google font CSS blocked equally. Startup ends at sb-ready plus two animation frames. Large cases include 20 scattered navigation calls, a real title edit followed by first and nine warm JSON state collections, five independent filmstrip scrolls, entering Scroll view and five distant main-deck jumps. Heap measurement follows a return to Focus. CPU_RATE optionally applies equal CDP CPU throttling to both versions. Timings exclude browser/server startup. engine_ms measures inline render/restore; initial useful layout is now deferred to the shell, so compare total startup and layout_ms as well. Durations are milliseconds; medians are across trials; no CPU profiler runs during timing.
